episode.title: Sampling and fit: a contrast
episode.summary: Choose to compare the current fit or resample and refit.
learning.fit-baseline.title: Fit the current data first
learning.fit-baseline.body: Wait for one real model fit, then choose what to do next.
learning.choose.title: Choose what to inspect next
learning.choose.body: Compare now, or sample again and refit.
learning.sample.title: Sample again
learning.sample.body: Obtain another observation sample from the current World.
learning.fit-again.title: Fit again
learning.fit-again.body: Fit the current model on the new observations.
learning.compare.title: Compare the fits
learning.compare.body: Inspect a completed comparison without calling it causal proof.
learning.end.title: Round complete
learning.end.body: The result describes this recorded run; it does not establish mastery.
